subject: Archetype Bank SIG + control evidence request
messages:
From: Daniel Hsu <dhsu@archetypebank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@archetypebank.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire + artifact list for vendor review

Mina —

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. As part of Archetype Bank's vendor assurance we need the completed SIG questionnaire and a mapped list of artifacts we can review to validate controls for data residency, encryption, key management, logging/retention, and change control. High-level asks:

- Completed SIG V2 (spreadsheet) or a control-by-control crosswalk to Archetype’s requirements.
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and ISO 27001 certificate if available.
- KMS/key rotation evidence (policy + 90/365-day rotation logs or attestation).
- Network diagram showing ingress/egress and any third-party peering; VPC/subnet notes.
- Sample anonymized access logs (7–14 days) and a short explanation of log retention/archival processes.
- A designated Redwood point of contact for artifact delivery and any legal/procurement redlines.

We’re trying to get this completed in two weeks to keep the procurement window open. Can you confirm: (1) what you can deliver within 10 business days; (2) whether Redwood will accept an NDA or an encrypted artifact upload link; and (3) who on your side will be the single owner for the evidence queue?

If easier, you can send a single archive with a manifest and we’ll work from that.

Regards,
Daniel Hsu
Sr. Security Engineer — Vendor Assurance
Archetype Bank

Attachment: Archetype_SIG_Request_20281003.pdf (PDF stub, 55KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Hsu <dhsu@archetypebank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + artifact list for vendor review

Daniel —

Thanks — we can take ownership of this and will stage an evidence bundle. Short answers up front:

1) Scope & timeline: We can deliver a control crosswalk (SIG -> Redwood controls) and a manifest within 5 business days. A redacted evidence bundle (SOC 2, KMS policy, network diagram, sample logs) can be ready within 10 business days. If you need raw logs beyond redaction, that will require IAC/PO review and may add time.

2) Delivery method: We prefer an encrypted S3 presigned upload or a secure ShareFile drop. We are also happy to work under your NDA; we have a standard entry NDA that speeds ingestion.

3) POC: I will be the primary evidence owner. Karthik and Neha are looped for procurement and attestation clarifications; Jasmine will manage the artifact packaging and redaction.

I’ve attached a first-pass control crosswalk (redwood_control-map-ARC-2028.xlsx) that maps Archetype’s SIG fields to our internal control IDs and indicates expected artifact types and owners. The spreadsheet includes columns: archetype_control_id, sig_control_text, redwood_control_id, artifact_needed, owner, estimated_delivery_days. Please review and flag any controls you want prioritized.

On timelines — if you confirm the SIG scope is limited to the Infrastructure/Encryption/Operations sections (not application-level customization), we’ll prioritize accordingly and aim to deliver the bundle by 2028-10-15.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Assurance & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_control-map-ARC-2028.xlsx (Excel stub, 48KB)

Date: 2028-10-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + artifact list for vendor review — MAA and timing

Daniel / team —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick commercial notes so procurement has visibility: we’ll produce the requested artifacts under our standard confidentiality terms. Two items to flag early: (1) SOC 2 report delivery is via a secured portal link (we can provide the report under NDA); (2) for any requests that require customer-specific logs beyond redaction there may be a scoped professional services billing milestone (we’ll identify those in the MAA).

I attached a short mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_arc_v1.docx) with milestone dates aligned to Mina’s timeline. Proposed milestones:
- Day 0: NDA signed / upload channel provisioned
- Day 2: Control crosswalk confirmed by Archetype (you flag priority controls)
- Day 5: Initial artifact manifest delivered by Redwood
- Day 10–12: Evidence bundle delivered (redacted logs, policies, diagram)
- Day 15–20: Follow-up deep-dive calls for any open controls

If that cadence works we’ll reserve the engineering time needed to produce sanitized logs and a walkthrough. Also happy to set an executive 15-min sync if Archetype’s security lead wants a brief platform orientation.

-Karthik
Sr. Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_arc_v1.docx (DOCX stub, 22KB)

Date: 2028-10-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Artifact delivery: redwood_evidence_bundle_oct2028.zip (initial package)

Daniel —

Per our plan, attached is the initial evidence bundle. The archive includes a manifest (evidence_manifest.csv) and the following redacted artifacts: 

- SOC2_TypeII_2027-10-Redacted.pdf (report stub)
- iso27001_certificate_redacted.pdf (if requested; included)
- kms_key_rotation_policy.pdf (policy text, redacted)
- kms_rotation_records_2028_q1-q3.csv (redacted, keyed entries only)
- network_diagram_vpc.drawio.png (annotated ingress/egress)
- sample_access_logs_anon_7days.log (redacted ACL timestamps)
- change_control_runbook_excerpt.pdf (deployment gating evidence)
- control_evidence_crosswalk.xlsx (control ids mapped to file names)

Notes and caveats:
- Logs are redacted to remove customer-specific identifiers; we can arrange a secure deep-dive under an approved NDA if Archetype needs unredacted material for a narrowly scoped control.
- KMS records include rotation date stamps and key IDs; we can provide HSM-attestation statements under a formal request.
- Where evidence is operational (e.g., runbook excerpts), we’ve included screenshots and excerpts rather than full operational playbooks.

Delivery method: Encrypted archive attached and also staged to a presigned S3 link. If you prefer a different transfer mechanism we can pivot.

Next steps: Please confirm receipt and flag any controls you want us to prioritize for follow-up calls. We’ve tentatively scheduled 2028-10-10 for a technical review call; Karthik will coordinate.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Assurance & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_evidence_bundle_oct2028.zip (ZIP stub, 6.2MB)
